title: Recordings in our storage with consent and retention; transcription and call summary through metered AI
goal: Keep call recordings safely in our own storage for a set time, announce recording to callers, and turn recordings into summaries and suggestions only when the agency has switched call AI on.
why: Recordings stay at the provider (only the URL is saved); recording_r2_key and recording_retention_days are never written or enforced; recording starts silently; transcription has a consumer but no producer and AI_EXTRACTION_QUEUE was unbound (now bound by R103); call extraction calls Anthropic directly without charging AI credits (services/ai-extraction.ts ~109-122); cost model items 8-9.
steps: Consent: recording policy setting announce (default) | off | on_request; inbound plays the agency's announcement before ringing; outbound plays it on answer or the in-call panel shows the line with a "consent given" tick (CALL-AUTOMATION 3.5).

calls.store_recording job on call.recording_ready: fetch the provider recording (credentials from the encrypted settings), put to R2 `${tenantId}/recordings/<callId>.mp3` (region bucket from R212 if merged), store recording_r2_key, bytes and expires_at from retention, then delete at the provider (provider method; mock in tests). Not paused by automations_paused.

Playback: GET /calls/:id/recording returns a short-lived signed URL (HMAC over key + expiry, verified by the files route) only for roles allowed by CALL-AUTOMATION 3.7, and logs the play to the activity log. Daily retention job deletes expired audio and keeps the call record and summary. Contact erasure (R208) deletes recordings.

Transcription producer: when call AI is on for the agency, credits suffice and duration >= 20 s, enqueue transcribe_call on AI_EXTRACTION_QUEUE; consumer uses the standard engine (Workers AI @cf/openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo through the AI router so credits are charged per minute: new credit class transcribe_standard = 3/min, transcribe_premium = 25/min with Deepgram when DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is set and the agency chose premium).

Summary: calls.summarise runs through AIRouter (metered, Workers AI JSON model by default), never a direct Anthropic call; output becomes suggestions (lead update, tasks, follow-up, draft reply) via the engine as CALL-AUTOMATION 2.4; "Not summarised: AI credits used up" state with "Summarise now".
tests: backend/test/call-recordings.test.ts: recording_ready stores to local R2 and calls provider delete (mock); signed URL works before expiry and fails after; salesperson cannot play another agent's call; retention job deletes audio after expiry; transcription is not enqueued when call AI is off or credits are 0; credit charge per minute recorded; summary path uses the router (stub the router; no real AI).
acceptance: No direct Anthropic call remains in call code (grep api.anthropic.com in services/ai-extraction.ts).
Recordings move to R2 and expire (tests).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
